on_screen_text.text: What motivated Maxwell Frost, the first Gen Z member of Congress, to run for office

The moment I decided to run was actually when I connected with my biological mother. I was adopted at birth, never knew anything about her, but I was at a crossroads, trying to make the decision on whether or not I wanted to run for Congress. And getting to hear about her story — the fact that she had me at the most vulnerable point in her life, really solidified all the things I believe in and the things that I want to fight for. And I hung up that phone and I said 'I'm running for Congress.'

spoken_summary: Maxwell Frost explains that the moment he decided to run for Congress was when he connected with his biological mother for the first time. He says he was adopted at birth and knew nothing about her. Hearing her story, especially that she had him at the most vulnerable point in her life, solidified his beliefs and what he wanted to fight for. After their conversation, he hung up the phone and said, "I'm running for Congress."
